description: Angular component for device info filtering in the Thingsboard UI, including UI logic, form handling, overlay management, and interaction with device profile service.

classes.name: DeviceInfoFilterComponent
classes.description: Angular component for filtering device information, managing filter state, UI overlay, and interaction with device profile data.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up form and subscriptions based on input data.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the filter value changes.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the filter value and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: toggleDeviceFilterPanel
methods.description: Opens or toggles the overlay panel for device filter options.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels overlay and resets form to current filter state.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Applies filter changes and closes overlay.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets filter form to initial configuration.

methods.name: deviceProfileChanged
methods.description: Updates internal state when device profile info changes.

methods.name: deviceInfoFilterConfigEquals
methods.description: Checks equality of two device filter configurations.

methods.name: updateDeviceInfoFilterForm
methods.description: Updates form controls with given filter data.

methods.name: deviceFilterUpdated
methods.description: Updates internal filter state and propagates change.

methods.name: updateButtonDisplayValue
methods.description: Updates the display text of the filter button based on current filter state.

methods.name: deviceFilterFromFormValue
methods.description: Creates a DeviceInfoFilter object from form values.
